text:
The evidence does not show what caused the loss. It shows where and when the loss happened, not why.

- **What was observed:** Hansen data show 0.6 ha of tree-cover loss in 2022, about 3.4% of the 17.6 ha asset.
- **Forest status:** The JRC 2020 map shows the whole loss area was forest in 2020. The national forest map classes 0.5 ha as native forest and 0.1 ha as outside mapped forest.
- **What it rules out:** None of the area is mapped as planted forest, so this is unlikely to be a plantation harvest.
- **Corroboration:** The event meets the corroboration rule, because a later year was observed and JRC agreed on 100% of the area.
- **Not counted:** A further 0.2 ha of loss in patches under 0.5 ha was left out as below the event threshold.

Clearing, fire, storm damage and other causes all remain possible. Telling them apart would need higher-resolution imagery, fire
